title: Verify MSVC prerequisite provenance
summary: Make the Tauri prerequisite gate prove the Visual Studio C++ workload, developer environment, x64 linker layout, and Microsoft binary metadata.
reason: Remediate P2 AUDIT-FIND-W09-011. The prereq script previously accepted the first PATH command named link and could label Git/MSYS link.exe as the MSVC linker.
behavior_before: Any PATH command named link satisfied RequireBuildTools before Visual Studio-specific discovery ran; VsDevCmd and Microsoft binary provenance were not part of the prereq result.
behavior_after: The prereq gate ignores PATH link commands, queries vswhere for the VC x86/x64 component, requires VsDevCmd.bat, restricts link.exe to Hostx64/x64 below that installation, and validates Microsoft version metadata before RequireBuildTools can pass.
tests_added: Fixture probe accepts a vswhere-discovered VC workload only when VsDevCmd, Hostx64/x64 link.exe, and Microsoft linker metadata all agree.
Fixture probes fail closed for non-Microsoft metadata and a missing VsDevCmd.
A hostile PATH link.cmd with no Visual Studio workload cannot satisfy RequireBuildTools.
manual_validation: PowerShell parser checks passed for the prerequisite helper and prereq entrypoint.
Real-machine CheckOnly RequireBuildTools passed against Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools, VsDevCmd.bat, Hostx64/x64 link.exe, and Microsoft linker version 14.44.35226.0.
Adversarial prerequisite fixture suite passed: 4 tests covering valid provenance, hostile PATH, missing VsDevCmd, and non-Microsoft metadata.
Full Tauri scaffold plus prerequisite fixture suite passed: 100 tests.
Canonical Test-TauriShell-Build.ps1 passed JavaScript syntax, npm cargo check, and all 62 Rust library tests.
Project index/dependency graph and feature file map checks passed.
Summary-integrity, feature-card, and risky-registry tooling passed: 30 tests and 70 subtests.
Risky-file registry and architecture guardrails passed; god-file guard reported the unchanged baseline of 0 errors and 51 warnings.
Global summary freshness reported only the same six pre-existing stale files outside this packet.
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage passed with 1,151 valid packets before completion.
rollback_plan: Revert the prerequisite helper, prereq integration, fixture tests, generated summaries/maps, and this packet together. Do not restore PATH-first link discovery without equivalent Visual Studio workload and binary provenance validation.
notes: This is a non-mutating developer/release diagnostic change. It does not launch Tauri, the backend, the media pipeline, or any media tool, and representative real-media validation is not required.
